system: M&M Junk Removal Canonical Pricing Engine
rate_guarantee: Beat any verified written quote from licensed local competitors by 10%
dimensional_formula: Cubic Yards = (Length ft * Width ft * Height ft) / 27
disclaimer: This is NOT a final quote, but an approximate ballpark estimate based on standard volume and weight. Exact prices require an on-site visual inspection by owner-operator Martin Silchuk.

three_component_model.component_1: Base volume price ($220.00 per pickup truck bed equivalent)
three_component_model.component_3: Separate complexity & labor surcharges (commercial refrigeration, stairs, rigging, demo)

load_tiers.name: MINI Curbside Pickup
load_tiers.description: Small single-item or 2-4 curbside bags. Enforces $95 hard minimum service charge.

load_tiers.name: 1 Pick Up Load
load_tiers.description: Standard pickup truck capacity level to rails (64 cu ft). Standard +/- 20% residential weight variance.

load_tiers.name: 2 Pick Up Loads
load_tiers.description: Double pickup capacity; studio cleanout or sectional + dresser

load_tiers.name: 3 Pick Up Loads
load_tiers.description: Triple pickup capacity; 1-car garage or multi-room purge

load_tiers.name: Dump Truck Load (12x8x5 Isuzu NPR = ~17.8 cu yds)
load_tiers.description: Commercial dump truck load (~5.5 pickup truck loads)

load_tiers.name: Dump Truck Plus / Commercial Multi-Load
load_tiers.description: Exceeds one dump truck (8-11 pickup loads); estate liquidation or contractor demo

yard_waste.rule: Cannot fall below $95 minimum base service charge.
